articles.headline: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
articles.blurb: Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes, or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. SELFWRITE lets the model write its own weights. Each generation, the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives. It can raise gate accuracy and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees without a single gradient step.

articles.headline: The Incredible, Elegant DNA Repair System Makes Gene Editing Work

This ability evolved essentially at the same time as DNA, as it is impossible to have stable genetic information without DNA repair. The mechanisms are essential to the evolutionary lineage of all known life. Scientists and doctors experimenting with gene editing use these natural self-editing and repair tools to insert, delete, or mutate genes to study and treat disease.

articles.headline: K-pop back in China? Summit talks spark ‘hope and apprehension’
